description: The last ChatGPT Desktop build before the Codex rename, downloaded from OpenAI's own URL, so com.openai.chat is proved by a real install instead of by a record from a retired runner image.
why: com.openai.chat is a single value here, not 10-desktop-apps' either-or list, because pinning it is the reason this scenario exists. must_find alone cannot do that: com.openai.codex satisfies it too. forbid_rows asserts the current build is absent, so the evidence comes only from the pre-rename build.
known_gaps: The bundle id only. A direct download leaves no Homebrew record, so the `chatgpt` brew route is not exercised here; 10-desktop-apps covers it.
